rationale: The evidence explicitly states: "The claim that the Sun had been confirmed to harbor a previously undetected magnetic anomaly was later disproven." This directly contradicts the claim that the Sun *was* confirmed to harbor such an anomaly, as the evidence asserts that this confirmation was disproven (i.e., shown to be false).
review_note: Correctly identifies disproof of the confirmation claim.
